title: Portugal's leading independent OutSystems partner Truewind is now VINCI's Axians
content:
Truewind, recorded as Portugal's leading independent OutSystems partner at Elite tier, has been acquired by VINCI Energies and now trades as Axians. The workbook carries both a name correction and an M&A flag on the row, marking it as a recent change rather than a long-standing arrangement.

The acquisition changes the category the lead belongs to. Independence was the qualifying attribute — an independent Elite partner decides its own technology positioning, while a subsidiary of a French infrastructure group inherits group alliances, procurement and architecture standards. The same criterion that rules out NTT Data Spain on foreign ownership now applies here, and the OutSystems Elite status was already an app-layer slot occupancy problem before the deal.

The second flag on the row is procedural: like NextWave, this entry was never scored on v3 and its priority is a mechanical rescore on size and slot occupancy, with the OSS-portfolio screen still to run. So the row combines a substantive change in the world with a known gap in the assessment, and the priority 2 attached to it predates both. Anything acted on here should start from the post-acquisition entity, not the record.
